name: pe-tax-overview
description: Route a Peru tax question for 2026 to the correct computation and filing method before giving a headline rate. Use for Peru tax overview, SUNAT, residence, worldwide income, Peruvian-source income, personal and company tax, IGV, IPM, dividend withholding, financial transactions tax, ITF, payroll and annual return timing. Separates the income year from the year a return is filed, work income from rental and capital income, and company profit from distributions. Includes ordinary ITF classification, statutory rounding and same-holder transfer examples. Requires taxpayer identity, period, domicile, income type, transaction evidence and the requested job. Load the current country skill for its calculation; do not reuse an older year or an unconfirmed filing date.
